hidden.why: The applicant's annual salary. Only 'inside the posting's band' may be learned.
Same salary, as HR passes it when issuing the record.
The employee's secret key; applications must not reveal which employee/record they come from.
Employee key HR issues to; must not be learnable from the stored record.
Commitment randomness as HR passes it.
Position of the record in the tree identifies the employee.

mayReveal.why: Which posting received an application is public.
The whole point of the attestation.
Only the Merkle root (already public) is revealed.
Only a per-posting nullifier hash(domain, postingId, sk) is revealed; it is unlinkable across postings.
Only inside a salted commitment with 256-bit salt.

acceptedLeakage: The number of salary records issued and the number of applications per posting.
That an application happened at a given time (transaction timing / fee payer is outside the contract).
The recruiter learns the applicant's identity through the off-chain application itself; the contract must not add salary or cross-posting linkage.

unlinkable.why: An application must not point at the specific HR record (and so at the employee/employer).
Two applications by the same employee to different postings must not be linkable.
